absolute_direction_policy.name: direction_rank_simple
absolute_direction_policy.purpose: Simplification ablation: positive price direction plus cost-aware momentum; Alpha6 relative score only ranks eligible symbols. Remove independent Alpha6 score/side, f4, f5, breadth and two-round vetoes for this offline variant.

execution.gate_cost: max(recorded selected entry gate cost, scenario roundtrip cost)
execution.fill_cost: scenario roundtrip cost split equally between entry and exit; actual realized execution costs are not known for hypothetical orders
execution.execution_delay: Entry at the next completed 1H close after the decision window. Existing stop/target orders are modeled intrabar; time exits use the observed hour close.
execution.intrabar_stop_rule: Test the stop before take-profit using hourly high/low; same-bar ambiguity is resolved against the strategy; gaps fill at the worse available opening price.
execution.history_gap_rule: Missing observations cannot confirm consecutive signals; no entry without complete causal bars and a current recorded quote.
